question: HF 16 is related to KI 8 in a certain way. In the same way, RP 10 is related to US 5. To which of the following is NL 6 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**HF 16 is related to KI 8,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e6471e6dbb945de71c9038208bca7d87ded5a8a5211b3dfbd317091aa07fb85.png] 

**RP 10 is related to US 5,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26ba8f8bdb191fdea8514a87aa70b8c059bc70cfac1340a2b4fba73db73e6a97.png] 

Similarly,

**NL 6 is related to,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07fb2716a44696d1e02ae328fb37211d8c6ce6eaa7ff95d147e59faaf726073f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****QO 3"**.
